$comment: TF-C79 (D-CSUBSET-INLINE-FUNCTION-SPECIFIER): an UNCALLED C99 6.7.4p7 inline definition must not be emitted -- the shape Apple's `<sys/cdefs.h>` puts in front of every macOS TU (MEASURED: DSS predefines `__STDC_VERSION__` >= 199901L and does NOT define `__GNUC__`, which makes `__header_inline` expand to plain `inline`; `__header_always_inline` degrades to the same thing because its `always_inline` decoration is `#ifdef __GNUC__`-gated). ★ THE ASSERTION IS NOT 'IT LINKED' -- an emitted body would link too if it were self-contained. `never_called` deliberately calls `__dss_undescribed_helper`, declared and defined NOWHERE: suppress the body (correct) and nothing ever references it, so the program links and exits 42; emit the body (broken) and the reference goes live and the link fails loud K_SymbolUndefined. That is a red-on-disable no symbol-table dump could express as an exit code. This is also precisely why the no-external-definition state is NOT encoded as a `weak` binding -- weak would EMIT these never-called bodies and drag every symbol they mention into the link. VERIFIED clang-clean and the clang -O0 binary independently exits 42 (clang likewise emits nothing for the uncalled inline definition).
